faq.title: FAQ
faq.sub: Hourly cleaning and upholstery in Valencia — clear answers.

items.q: How much is hourly cleaning in Valencia?
items.a: €18/hour, minimum 2 hours. Estimate the total in the calculator and book online.

items.q: How much is sofa / upholstery cleaning in Valencia?
items.a: Minimum order €40. If items cost more (e.g. a €50 sofa), you pay only that price. We clean on-site.

items.q: Do you offer upholstery / dry cleaning of furniture in Valencia?
items.a: Yes: sofas, armchairs, chairs, mattresses and rugs. Book on the site or WhatsApp +34 651 156 133.

items.q: How do I book a cleaning in Valencia?
items.a: Build your order in the calculator, pick day and time, leave address and phone — or message WhatsApp. Last order of the day: before 20:00.
